name: TypeScript Strict Mode
description: Enable strict TypeScript — ban `any`, require explicit return types, strictNullChecks, noUncheckedIndexedAccess

name: No Implicit Any
description: Never use implicit `any`; annotate every function parameter, variable, and return type explicitly

name: Immutable by Default
description: Prefer `readonly`, `as const`, `Readonly<T>`; avoid mutation; use functional update patterns

name: Type-Safe Error Handling
description: Use `Result<T, E>` or discriminated unions for errors; never `throw` untyped exceptions in async flows

name: React Hooks Rules
description: Enforce rules of hooks — exhaustive deps arrays, no conditional hooks, stable callback refs with useCallback

name: No Prop Drilling
description: Max 2 levels of prop passing; use Context, Zustand, or composition patterns for deeper state sharing

name: Component Size Limit
description: Each component file ≤ 150 lines; one default export per file; extract sub-components and hooks to separate files

name: Accessibility Required
description: All interactive elements need ARIA labels, keyboard event handlers, and sufficient color contrast (WCAG 2.1 AA)

name: No Console Logs in Production
description: Remove all console.log/warn/error before merging; use a structured logger (e.g. pino, winston) for server, no logging in client bundles

name: No Magic Numbers
description: All numeric literals ≥ 2 digits must be named constants in a constants file; include a comment explaining intent

name: Single Responsibility
description: Each function/module does exactly one thing; max cyclomatic complexity of 10; functions ≤ 30 lines

name: Error Handling Required
description: Every async function must handle errors; never swallow exceptions silently; always log or surface errors to the caller

name: Conventional Commits
description: All commits follow Conventional Commits spec: `type(scope): description`; valid types: feat/fix/chore/docs/refactor/test/perf

name: Merge Request Checklist
description: MR description must include: what changed, why it changed, how to test, screenshots for UI changes, migration notes for DB changes

name: Code Review Standards
description: Reviews must check: correctness, security, performance, readability, test coverage; comments must be actionable; no rubber-stamping

name: Branch Naming Convention
description: Branch names follow `type/ticket-short-description` (e.g. `feat/AUTH-42-login-page`); no long-running feature branches > 3 days

name: Test Coverage Minimum
description: New code requires ≥ 80% unit test coverage; critical paths (auth, payments, data mutations) require 100%; test file co-located with source

name: Test Naming Convention
description: Test names follow `should <do X> when <condition Y>`; group related tests with `describe` by feature; one assertion focus per test

name: PostgreSQL Query Rules
description: Always use parameterized queries; no `SELECT *` in production; add indexes for every FK and WHERE filter column; use transactions for multi-step writes

name: Java Code Style
description: Follow Google Java Style Guide; max method length 30 lines; use `Optional<T>` instead of null returns; constructor injection only; no static mutable state
